tasks.title: Run All Tests and Identify Failures
tasks.description: Run the complete test suite using `npx vitest run` to identify all failing tests. Report which tests are failing and what the error messages are. Test files include: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
acceptance_criteria: All test failures documented with error messages

tasks.title: Fix Failing Tests
tasks.description:
Based on the test failures identified in QA-001, fix all failing tests. This may involve:
- Fixing test assertions that don't match actual behavior
- Fixing component code if tests reveal bugs
- Updating test setup if configuration is incorrect
- Ensuring all imports and mocks are correct

Read the following test files and corresponding component files:
- src/App.test.tsx and src/App.tsx
- src/components/Button.test.tsx and src/components/Button.tsx
- src/components/Display.test.tsx and src/components/Display.tsx
- src/components/Calculator.test.tsx and src/components/Calculator.tsx
- src/test/setup.ts (test configuration)

Fix all issues so that tests accurately validate the code and all tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: All test failures from QA-001 are resolved
Test assertions correctly validate component behavior

tasks.title: Verify All Tests Pass
tasks.description: Run the complete test suite using `npx vitest run` to verify all tests now pass after fixes from REQ-001. Confirm zero test failures.
acceptance_criteria: All tests pass with zero failures
